text:
Thank you for writing to the Companion Animal Travel Desk, and I am sorry the delayed departure made your trip harder for you and your companion animal. We understand how upsetting it is when plans change at the airport, especially when you have already done the careful work of preparing documents, carriers, and comfort items for a smooth journey. Our team reviews these cases with safety in mind first, then with a practical focus on making the next steps clear and respectful.

<<FACT F109>>

For the situation you described, the important part is that our desk can help you sort out what applies to your booking and what supporting details the crew or service team may need. When a departure is held back, we look at the full chain of events, including whether the animal was properly checked in, whether the carrier met cabin or hold standards, and whether any part of the process could have been communicated sooner. We know that even when the cause is outside your control, the wait can feel long and the care for your animal can become more stressful than it should be.

Please be assured that the Companion Animal Travel Desk shares practical handling guidance with crews, so everyone involved has the same expectations for calm, respectful communication and safe animal transport. If you are traveling again with Aurelia Skyways, it helps to keep your companion's papers easy to reach, confirm the carrier fit before arrival, and let staff know early if your pet needs a little extra time or space during boarding. Those small steps often reduce confusion and make the airport experience easier for everyone.

If there were signs of distress, missed handoff details, or any concern about the condition of the carrier or the animal during the delay, our safety review process will take that seriously. We want passengers to feel heard when something goes wrong, and we also want crews to have clear information so they can respond well in the moment. A prompt, respectful report is the best way to help us close the loop and improve the next trip.

We appreciate your patience and the care you showed your companion animal despite the disruption. Companion Animal Travel Desk
